english_today.topic: Help a friend choose a balanced reset after an exhausting week
practice_sentences: I would choose a quiet morning at home and one short plan outside later in the day.
This is better because it gives you time to rest without staying inside all weekend.
You can still meet one friend for coffee because a small social plan may lift your mood.
Let me think for a moment—if you feel tired, keep the plan simple and go home early.
You do not have to make the whole weekend perfect; just choose one thing that helps you reset.
sentence_hints: 先休息，再安排一個小外出。
第一個理由：休息但不完全悶在家。
第二個理由：小小社交可能改善心情。
想一下再補充一個有彈性的做法。
用溫暖的結尾鼓勵對方。
